funFacts.title: Interesting Facts About Studying in China
funFacts.subtitle: Interesting information you should know about studying in China
funFacts.0: China has more than 40 universities in the global top 500 rankings, offering world-class education.
funFacts.1: Many international students in China receive full scholarships covering tuition, accommodation, and monthly stipends.
funFacts.2: China is investing heavily in becoming an education hub with over $10 billion annually in international education.
funFacts.3: Students in China gain exposure to the world's second-largest economy and fastest-growing job market.
funFacts.4: The Chinese government offers over 50,000 scholarships to international students annually.
